summary: Haitian, lives in Port-au-Prince, software engineer with a background in electronic engineering, specializes in mobile and web app development (React Native, Laravel, Node.js), speaks Haitian Creole and French natively, fluent in English, enjoys reading (especially science fiction and fantasy), avid gamer (Apex Legends, Dirt Rally 2), interested in digital painting and drawing, uses a Mac Mini and MacBook Air for work, prefers open-source software and Linux, values mental health and work-life balance, has a strong interest in technology and programming languages, actively engages in online communities related to software development and technology, has a family structure that includes a partner, emphasizes the importance of personal knowledge management and effective note-taking.
